title: IN WHICH THE MASTER OF THE
RUNS GREAT RISK OF LOSING A REWARD OF TWO HUNDRED POUNDS
summary_hover: Phileas Fogg, Aouda, and Fix brave a violent typhoon aboard the pilot-boat Tankadere, racing to reach Shanghai to catch the Yokohama steamer.
summary_detail: Determined to catch the Yokohama steamer, Phileas Fogg charters the small pilot-boat Tankadere to take him, Aouda, and Fix from Hong Kong to Shanghai. En route, they endure a terrifying typhoon but hold their course, reaching the Shanghai River just as the American steamer is departing. In a final bid to catch it, Fogg orders the pilot to fire a distress cannon.
